payload.instruction: Stuffing the paper into the cup
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the paper visibly stuffed inside the cup, rather than merely resting nearby or on its rim?
node.criteria: Pass if the image shows the paper placed inside the cup with visible evidence it has been stuffed into it. Fail if the paper is visibly outside the cup or only resting nearby or on its rim. Unknown if the image does not provide enough evidence to distinguish these cases.
node.binding: The paper must be stuffed into the cup; merely being nearby or on the rim does not satisfy the requested outcome.
